projects.name: Rubrik DR backup
notes: [status email 2026-10-21] Overall status flagged RISK (previous 10/14 email was ON-TRACK). Blocker: shipment contract, legal should prepare it (Karl/Karen); escalation might be needed; no ETA.
[standup transcript 2026-10-19] Calvin: Oracle RAC backup now running under Rubrik (thanks to Earle and Prajeet); the hold-up is contracts for shipping. Karl: ping Karen Hodgson on contract status.
[standup transcript 2026-10-20] Calvin: daily run mode, logs picked up hourly, looks OK; need the contract to ship (three appliances). Jaime confirmed three are shipping.
[standup transcript 2026-10-21] Calvin: Rubrik green; waiting on contract; latest from legal was that they did not see the attachments. Karl: no good estimate for legal turnaround.
[rubrik transcript 2026-10-21] Karen was pinged Monday, still no meaningful response (legal said attachments not seen; Karen to resend). Igor suggested involving more people to speed it up.

[rubrik transcript 2026-10-21] Earle: Manchester DBA background work done except backups. Backup scripts being split (FlashBlade vs U04 scripts); expects to finish by Sunday (10/25) with level 0/1 backup to the CA backup server; no impact on Rubrik schedule (6am incrementals, same as Secaucus).

[rubrik transcript 2026-10-21] Secaucus DBA access to Rubrik and RAC backup training still wanted; Calvin: users likely next week, process must be formalized for audit. Igor to create Jira ticket assigned to Calvin.

[rubrik transcript 2026-10-21] Manchester network preparation: network team provided required-actions list (switch ports 12x1G IPMI, 24x10G; subnets 10.49.4.0/27 SEC and 10.17.4.0/27 MCR; DHCP reservations; firewall rules; cluster-to-cluster connectivity). Igor to create tracking ticket.
[rubrik transcript 2026-10-21] SASP standalone database decommission is a RAC project task, not Rubrik; Rubrik was a dependency and is done.

[status email 2026-10-21] Completed: IOSP-1012 (10/16 18:00 UTC) enable Rubrik RAC backup; RM-1658 CA Backup VLAN on RAC hosts (SEC); RM-1661 Oracle Wallet on production RAC; IOSP-880 (10/17-10/20) validate Rubrik RAC backup and replication.

[status email 2026-10-21] Timeline: Oct 6-27 appliances ready for pickup (IOSP-1010 10/23, IOSP-1009 10/24, IOSP-1013 10/26); Oct 27-Nov 9 international shipment (IOSP-1015); Nov 9-16 rack/cable (IOSP-1004, IOSP-1005); Nov 16-Dec 6 commissioning (IOSP-1006), Manchester network config TBD; Nov 30-Dec 6 production testing (IOSP-1007); Dec 7 fully production in Europe (IOSP-1008).

[rubrik chat 2026-10-19] Earle: all that is left for Secaucus is granting DBAs Rubrik access and a training guide/session. Earle also posted RCAT backup create/restore preview timings from 10/18-10/19.

[rubrik chat 2026-10-20] Earle (with Prajeet): OK to stop backups on scdpcasasp1, put the standalone DB in no-archivelog mode, shut it down; Prajeet to remove it from Data Guard. Earle: daily RCAT backup is mandatory with Oracle and he sees no need for a Rubrik one too.

IOSP-1010 Prepare shipment plan and contracts
